mintAuthority.summary: syrupUSDC is Maple's ERC-4626 strategy-vault receipt for USDC lent to institutional borrowers; Ethereum is the sole canonical native-issuance deployment, where shares are minted against USDC deposits and do not create base USDC supply, so durable mint authority is inherited from USDC (usdc-circle). Base, Arbitrum, and Solana are CCIP bridge representations assessed under Bridge Risk, not additional Mint Authority deployments.

controls.label: Maple syrupUSDC ERC-4626 vault token
controls.capDescription: syrupUSDC shares are minted/burned by the Maple ERC-4626 vault against USDC deposits and FIFO-queued withdrawals; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDC supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095801, asset() returned USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48; the token's EIP-1967 implementation and correctly addressed admin slots were zero. The verified MaplePool token is not a proxy, but manager() returned upgradeable PoolManager 0x7ad5ffa5fdf509e30186f4609c2f6269f4b6158f, whose implementation() was 0xfe02be1ad28edfd8e3dd6f29c402b244c2a258b8. Token immutability does not establish immutability of the manager-dependent accounting or deposit controls.

controls.label: Inherited USDC MasterMinter
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC supply is issuer-minted by Circle via the MasterMinter. Live masterMinter() reads resolve to this contract, which can authorize minters for the base USDC monetary supply.

controls.label: Inherited USDC token owner
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC token owner/admin can authorize USDC mint administration; syrupUSDC wrapper shares inherit this base USDC authority.

controls.label: Maple syrupUSDC upgradeable PoolManager
controls.capDescription: MaplePool delegates native share-mint eligibility, liquidity limits and totalAssets accounting to this upgradeable PoolManager. The scheduled pool delegate or security admin can request a factory-approved implementation upgrade. This affects syrupUSDC share issuance and does not grant authority to mint base USDC.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095936, MaplePool manager() returned 0x7ad5ffa5fdf509e30186f4609c2f6269f4b6158f and manager implementation() returned 0xfe02be1ad28edfd8e3dd6f29c402b244c2a258b8. poolDelegate was 0xc1e18ffd8825ffb286d177ddebeba345ec70b49f; securityAdmin was 0x6b1a78c1943b03086f7ee53360f9b0672bd60818; factory was 0xe463cd473ecc1d1a4ecf20b62624d84dd20a8339. Verified MaplePool deposit/mint functions use manager canCall and totalAssets. Verified manager upgrade requires a valid scheduled pool-delegate call or the security admin; its factory checks an enabled upgrade path. Governor controls factory implementation registration and path admission. No exact current schedule delay or exhaustive enabled-version census is asserted.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771046 on 2026-08-16, syrupUSDC asset() = USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, totalAssets() = 1,049,015,912.169937 USDC, and totalSupply() = 890,051,815.053496 shares; EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots were both zero, confirming the non-upgradeable MaplePool wrapper. Base 0x660975730059246a68521a3e2fbd4740173100f5, Arbitrum 0x41ca7586cc1311807b4605fbb748a3b8862b42b5, and Solana AvZZF1YaZDziPY2RCK4oJrRVrbN3mTD9NL24hPeaZeUj are CCIP burn/mint representations rather than independent native-issuance deployments, so their token roles, pools, receiver, timelocks, and Solana authorities are assessed under bridgeRouteRisk. Durable mint authority inherits from reviewed parent USDC (usdc-circle). Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: Maple launched recurring The Network Firm reports on 2026-05-07, sourcing loan collateral directly from custodians and onchain activity for syrupUSDC; the current report dashboard was reviewed 2026-07-15. No exact issuer/product prudential registry entry was found. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: local syrupUSDC shares are immutably deposit-gated by USDC; Maple's recurring third-party reporting supports periodic attestation-only posture.
